title: Merger Announcements and Insider Trading Activity: An Empirical Investigation

rival_explanations: the pre-announcement price runup and abnormal trading volume were caused by legal, reportable open-market trading by registered insiders rather than by illegal leakage and tipping of nonpublic information
the pre-announcement cumulative abnormal return is a spurious random-walk drift artifact rather than a genuine market reaction to leaked information

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (successfully acquired U.S. firms across many sectors, e.g. electronics, oil, food, drugs, chemicals)
context.country_region: United States (NYSE, AMEX, and Over-the-Counter Market)
